text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp was in its final 
stretch. As for how Sakura Laurel was 
doing—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... Phew...
choice_data_list:
Good work, your stamina has been steadily 
increasing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm totally fine! My foot just 
got caught a bit weirdly...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The strain is completely different 
depending on the location. Though 
adjustments have been made taking that 
into account.
choice_data_list:
Plus, there's the glare reflecting off the 
sand.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see. We definitely need to be careful of 
heatstroke too, then!

And as I brought Sakura Laurel under the 
shelter to let her rest—
(Eeeeeeek...!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, so cool! Brian-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Talk about a special perk for us! I heard 
the press isn't allowed into this training 
camp at all!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it's all because everyone 
comes running to watch Brian-san run!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm so glad we're fellow 
students~... Good luck in the Kikuka Sho 
too, Brian-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...! Come to think of it, I was wondering 
why I hadn't seen any reporters around 
this year, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes. Truly—
(Rumble rumble rumble...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's a back you can't help but look up 
to, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, break time's over! I'm heading 
back to finish up my training.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Huh, there's still yakisoba left over!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Save it for later! I'll eat it when I'm 
done! I'm gonna run in the Kikuka Sho too, 
after all...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...The final crown: the Kikuka Sho.
choice_data_list:
Looks like some of the girls are feeling 
the pressure.

Some of the girls are feeling the 
pressure, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Still, I won't hesitate anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
These legs are still weak, and they can't 
handle 100% of the load just yet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Once all our worries are gone, I'll push 
these legs to their absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"And we will surpass them. —The strongest 
of our generation."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! Shall we move on to the next 
routine as well?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I have to rest my legs, so... If I 
remember correctly, the next menu item is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪ I'll go get ready!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ready, and... Hmph! ...Ngh... hup...!

And so, while switching over to a workout 
plan focused on strength training with 
Sakura Laurel—
Uuuugh... Take this!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Uhh... mmph, hup☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hup☆ Hup★

Before I knew it, two little Umamusume 
were standing by my side... Marvelous 
Sunday and Mayano Top Gun.

If I recall correctly, both of them are 
Junior class Umamusume who haven't debuted 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Maya-chan and Mave-chan are doing the 
same menu too?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ I thought maybe copying Laurel-san 
would make Maya look mature too~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup, Maya's gonna grow into a sparkling 
adult too! Bang☆

It's fine to follow their lead, but asking 
a pre-debut body to handle the same 
training regimen as the Classic class is 
pushing it too far.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The muscle built during the Junior Class 
period will affect future running 
performance, after all...
choice_data_list: Hmm... Laurel, do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...? What might it be?
choice_data_list: Flex both arms and make a muscle!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Like this?
choice_data_list:
Marvelous Sunday makes a circle with both 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...? Like thiiis~?
choice_data_list:
And put your arms through Laurel's to make 
a circle!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! Come here, Mave-chan!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ! Okaaay☆

Holding her pose from earlier, Sakura 
Laurel lifted Marvelous Sunday up with her 
upper arms!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Kyahahahaha☆ Laurel! You're amaziiing★☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Wah!? Muscular just like Dad...!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, what about Maya?! Laurel, do Maya 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, sure! Maya-chan, come join us too!

And so, while dealing with the two 
Umamusume, Sakura Laurel's strength 
training continued.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Guts...?

And the place Sakura Laurel and I headed 
out to was a local summer festival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Oh, my~? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You call it training, but are you actually 
asking me out on a date?

To clear up Sakura Laurel's 
misunderstanding, I quickly point toward 
our destination.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Katanuki?

It's a game where you use a needle or 
similar tool to slowly carve out shapes 
like animals or umbrellas printed on the 
surface of flat wafer-like candy.
choice_data_list: You'll need focus and guts for this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It is a game where delicate finesse and 
unwavering mental focus till the very end 
are both absolutely essential.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Understood, let's take on the challenge! 
We might as well go for the highest 
difficulty—
Marvelouuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mister, mister! Give me another hard one☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya too! Mine's all gone, so I want 
another one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Mave-chan and Maya-chan?

Right there were Marvelous Sunday, also 
known as "Mabe-chan," and Mayano Top Gun, 
also known as "Maya-chan."

If I recall correctly, both of them are 
Junior class Umamusume who haven't debuted 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Katanuki Vendor Man
text_block_list.text: Whoa, did you girls clear it again?!

text_block_list.name: Katanuki Vendor Man
text_block_list.text:
"If you want harder than that, your only 
option is Extreme Hell Difficulty~."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous & Maya
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll do that~☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! Both of you are amazing...! Mmm~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mister, I'd like one Extreme Hell Level as 
well, please!

text_block_list.name: Katanuki Vendor Man
text_block_list.text: Huh!? O-On it~!

And so, Sakura Laurel's challenge began, 
but—
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Katanuki Vendor Man
text_block_list.text:
Ah... another miss, little miss. Want to 
try an easier one next time?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Right! I'll stick with this after all! 
Please let me try one more time!

text_block_list.name: Katanuki Vendor Man
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh!? This is already my seventeenth 
try, you know...?

Sakura Laurel persevered patiently, 
holding out for as long as time allowed...
